title: Món này có trứng hay đậu phộng không?
englishTitle: Does this have egg or peanuts?
pronunciation: mon nai koh choong hai dow fohng khong
summary: A focused guide to when Món này có trứng hay đậu phộng không? sounds more natural than Tôi bị dị ứng đậu phộng.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Món này có trứng hay đậu phộng không? is useful when "Does this have egg or peanuts?" needs a slightly different tone or setting. Use this after the allergy warning when you need to check the ingredients directly.

sections.title: Break it down

sections.title: Traveler insight
sections.body: In Food & Drink, the reply often comes as a clear reply, a pointed detail, or a simple follow-up. Say Món này có trứng hay đậu phộng không? once, pause, and watch for the reply before adding another sentence. Point to the actual item, menu line, size, or photo while you say it.
